overview:
After a low scoring GW last time, GW14 ended up being one of the highest scoring weeks. There was no changes at the top this week as all teams in the top 5 had fairly average scoring weeks. In fact the highest scores this week came from teams in the middle of the table, with 3 mid-table teams scoring 87pts or more.

The biggest winner this week was stranger Mings who scored a massive 96pts and moved up 3 places to 6th, putting pressure on the teams above. I don't know who were previously bottom scored an impressive 72pts this week, moving them off the bottom of the table.

The key to doing well in GW14 was captaining Haaland who scored 14pts after notching a goal and 2 assists in a 9-goal thriller against Fulham. Only 2 teams took the decision not to captain Haaland and there is only one single team in the league who haven't even selected Haaland at all (bold strategy Doyle).
totwDescription: stranger Mings are this week's TOTW with a huge 96pts and grab their second TOTW of the season. Captain Haaland contributed 28pts to the team, but there were decent performances across the whole team as Grealish, Doku, Guéhi, Woltemade and Burn all chipping in with goals and assists and clean sheets across the whole defence. Loving your work, Gaz 🥳
sackedDescription: Pure Worship are the only team in the league who haven't selected Haaland so it probably comes as no surprise that they are the lowest scoring team of GW14 with 39pts. Goals from Gordon and Watkins helped prevent a complete disaster but no clean sheets and captain Salah blanking meant another week in the trenches for Doyle's team.

otherUpdates.title: 👌🏻 Player of the Week
otherUpdates.content: Phil Foden (MCI 🩵 - £8.4m) is this week's POTW with 2 goals against Fulham, scoring 17pts. That's 4 goals in 2 games for Foden, who is starting to find form again after a number of injuries. He is obviously a high profile player and has a high TSB% of 19.9% but isn't selected by any teams in the League of Leg Ends - perhaps something teams will re-evaluate for GW15.

otherUpdates.title: ⏭️ Next Gameweek
otherUpdates.content: The deadline for locking in teams, transfers and chips for GW15 is Saturday 6th December at 11am.
